# Python v0.1.0 Release Evidence

This directory freezes evidence from `oceanbase/powercontext` release commit
`7b736206a53a6de6f43d4b517893ee1a80e7183d` (`powercontext-v0.1.0`). It is
separate from, and does not replace, the immutable Python v0.0.2 Oracle.

`authority.db`, `authority-rows.json`, `scheduler.db`, `domain-contract.json`,
and `handoff-report-digests.json` are generated by the public Python runtime in
the release's locked environment. `authority-rows.json` is the normalized
persistence snapshot used for cross-runtime comparison because SQLite database
bytes include writer-specific metadata.

The release lock retains Pydantic AI `2.29.0`, so `provider-matrix.json` is the
reviewed matrix shared with the v0.0.2 baseline. Its SHA-256 is nevertheless
recorded in this versioned manifest. `manifest.json` records the exact commit,
OpenAPI, prompt source and rendered prompt digests, normalized SQLite schema
digest, every fixture digest, and the 132-file/812-case release inventory.

Regenerate only against the exact release checkout and run the versioned CI
comparison; a new release must use another evidence directory.
